_readme: Tuned per-timeframe defaults, applied automatically based on TIMEFRAME. Anything set explicitly in .env or the shell overrides these. Run 'python rsi_midline_bot.py tune' to re-tune with walk-forward validation (it updates this file only if the winner holds up out-of-sample), or edit by hand and update 'tuned'/'notes' so the evidence stays with the numbers.

1Day.notes: Sell deepened 40 -> 35 after the 2026-07-12 630-combo sweep (RSI period x band x MA, 1095d + 2555d validation, 70/30 walk-forward): sell 30-35 beats sell 40 across nearly every period/band/MA and every symbol on both windows — a plateau, not a spike. 7y (2555d) walk-forward for 55/35 MA50, test window incl. the 2025 downtrend: test avg +50.5% vs +45.0% for the prior 55/40, worst-symbol test +36.5% vs +26.1% (full 7y +124% vs +128%, trades 13-17/symbol). 3y sell-35 variants also beat deployed OOS (+23.9% vs +22.4%). Evidence: 'EXP swp'/'EXP swp7y' rows in backtest_results.csv, findings in CLAUDE.md. Prior 55/40 evidence (2026-07-11 hand-tune) in git history. MA0 ~equal OOS; MA50 kept as downtrend-entry insurance. Note: tune's grid cannot see this combo (no deep-sell bands).

1Hour.notes: p14 55/45 plain (no MA, no volume, no HTF) from the 2026-07-13 RTH_ONLY re-sweep, 432 combos, 70/30 walk-forward ranked on train, COST_BPS=5: train +8.9%, test +4.5%, test-min +4.1% — positive on every symbol in both windows, ~44 trades/yr, on a plateau (p10 50/45, p10 55/40, p10 55/45 v1.5 also positive both windows). Evidence: 'EXP swpRTH1h' rows in backtest_results.csv. Replaced the untested filter guess; the 2026-07-12 all-hours pick (p21 60/40) did not survive the RTH correction (rank 218/432, train c5 +0.9%).

15Min.notes: 1y backtest (2025-07 to 2026-07, SPY/AAPL/MSFT): raw 50-cross churns ~800-950 trades/yr and loses badly. Band 55/45 + volume 1.5x + MA200 was best on every symbol (SPY +15.9% with 44% win rate, MSFT -0.8% vs -23% hold; AAPL improved but still negative). Volume confirmation is the single biggest intraday improvement. Still trails daily-bar buy&hold overall.

5Min.notes: Untested guess: even choppier than 15Min, so filters matter more; expect worse results overall. Run 'backtest' with TIMEFRAME=5Min before trusting.

1Min.notes: Not backtested and not recommended: at 1-minute bars, spread and slippage dominate any RSI edge. Kept only so the profile lookup never falls through silently.
